typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Site Location} as string,
		SNO as decimal(18,0),
		{Incident No } as string,
		{Date of Incident} as timestamp,
		{Closed Date} as timestamp,
		{Service Affected Non Service Affected} as string,
		{Incident Title} as string,
		{Equipment TAG} as string,
		{Equipment TAG Location  Description} as string,
		{Incident Description} as string,
		Impact as string,
		{Effected Equipment Details} as string,
		{Actions Taken} as string,
		{ RCA Status in Yes No} as string,
		Ownership as string,
		{Real Reason of Incident} as string,
		{Impact Type Partial Full} as string,
		{RCA NO } as string,
		{Action taken against the RCA } as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		Fname = $FileName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Impact as string,
		IncidentDescription as string,
		RCAStatus as string,
		Ownership as string,
		UploadDate as string,
		IncidentTitle as string,
		EquipmentTAGLocationDesc as string,
		RealReasonofIncident as string,
		SiteLocation as string,
		ServiceAffectedNonServiceAffected as string,
		ImpactType as string,
		IncidentNo as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		EquipmentTAG as string,
		RCANO as string,
		SNO as integer,
		ActionsTaken as string,
		EffectedEquipmentDetails as string,
		DateofIncident as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClosedDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ActiontakenagainstRCA as string,
		Fname as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Impact,
		IncidentDescription = {Incident Description},
		RCAStatus = { RCA Status in Yes No},
		Ownership,
		UploadDate,
		IncidentTitle = {Incident Title},
		EquipmentTAGLocationDesc = {Equipment TAG Location  Description},
		RealReasonofIncident = {Real Reason of Incident},
		SiteLocation = {Site Location},
		ServiceAffectedNonServiceAffected = {Service Affected Non Service Affected},
		ImpactType = {Impact Type Partial Full},
		IncidentNo = {Incident No },
		EtlUser,
		EquipmentTAG = {Equipment TAG},
		RCANO = {RCA NO },
		SNO,
		ActionsTaken = {Actions Taken},
		EffectedEquipmentDetails = {Effected Equipment Details},
		DateofIncident = {Date of Incident},
		ClosedDate = {Closed Date},
		ActiontakenagainstRCA = {Action taken against the RCA },
		Fname),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
